responsibility: Implements the canonical normalization query path that deeply folds query inputs, invokes projection and weak-type normalization queries when aliases are encountered, reinstates bound variables after canonicalization, and returns normalized values plus any generated obligations.
same_name_distinction: This `normalize.rs` is the canonical query normalization path: it folds query inputs, canonicalizes alias-containing pieces, invokes `tcx.normalize_canonicalized_*` queries, and reconstructs obligations/results, unlike the solver-local normalization implementations elsewhere.
